name: Return to Troyas
summary: Daryn Lightwind hands over her book, Feralas: A History, and asks you to take care of it. It goes to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold, who is surely eager for your return.

sections.title: A Borrowed Book
sections.body: With the Super Snapper FX behind you, Daryn Lightwind gives you her book and asks that you look after it. She urges you to hurry along, sure that Troyas is eager for your return. The book is bound for Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Troyas Reads
sections.body: Troyas is glad you brought the book. He looks it over, skims its pages, and exclaims that he thinks he has found it.

faq.answer: Daryn Lightwind's book, Feralas: A History.
Daryn Lightwind, who asks you to take care of it.
It follows The Super Snapper FX.
